notes: «عمن اخبره» is a transmitter the text does not name (rule 8), so it is unnamed in its place
«عن بعض الفقهاء» is unnamed; the saying («يوقف فقراء المؤمنين») is God's words, so God is not a link and the chain ends here
Thaqalayn's English sanad gives a different chain (Ibn Abi Umayr, Mansur, Ishaq ibn Ammar); the Arabic is read as written and the difference is filed as a fix

fixes.reason: Thaqalayn's English names Ibn Abi Umayr, Mansur and Ishaq ibn Ammar, but the Arabic text names ابن أبي البلاد and an unnamed «بعض الفقهاء».

evidence.quote: ابن أبي البلاد عمن اخبره عن بعض الفقهاء
